answer: Fresh-seed challenges make answers perishable. The required words rotate every epoch on a public beacon — sometimes mid-epoch — so nothing can be pre-written or recycled from a vine of stored texts: a stale submission dies on arrival, the stale-live gap opening like a canyon. Stockpiled essays for a hundred puppets are worthless within hours; only live, capable generation keeps pace. Like saffron, each seed is single-use and perishable — bulk-bought text carries no value by the time it is spent. Attacker cost: real-time composition for every identity, every epoch, forever.
